<b>Cogwork Haulers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small [[Cogwork Bugs|automaton]] [[Underworkers]] born and built to carry loads of dangerous flintflame.<ref>Cogwork Hauler [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small automaton with a shielded shell, intended to carry loads of dangerous flintflame. Born and built only to work until time stiffens its limbs."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Floats stationary in the air. If [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, it flies towards her, blinking for a few seconds before exploding, dealing {{Damage|2|type=Fire}}.

They also explode when dying, taking much knockback before that if defeated with the [[Needle]] or the [[Clawline]]{{MissingInfo}}. Deal damage quickly before it explodes and be sure that it is not close to both Hornet and a wall, or avoid its slow flight path.

Playing the [[Needolin]] causes it to explode in place.

== Location ==
Cogwork Haulers can be found in the [[Underworks]], near [[the Cauldron]]. In the room where there are regularly 8 Cogwork Haulers, three more can appear as an ambush after freeing a [[Flea]] that is stuck there.
